title: Double Counting Savings
description: Clarify your reserve versus future goals to prevent double counting funds for conflicting purposes.

segments.text: Is one balance serving both an emergency and a purchase? You must check if the same portion is counted twice.
Name the emergency role first. Then name your future purchase goal clearly in separate sections of that single account.
If you assign the same funds to both, an emergency claim reduces money available for your planned purchase immediately.
Inspect your notebook. Decide which specific portion is strictly committed to an obligation and keep it distinct.
Record which plan changes if funds are used today. Note the impact on your future goal timeline.
Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.
